summary: Iteration 111 — frontend E2E of the new two-dropdown related-record picker in CreateTaskDialog ('Tugas Baru') plus 2 backend spot-checks. All 6 requested scenarios PASS: type select exposes exactly the 6 expected options; record select is disabled with placeholder 'Pilih jenis dulu' until a type is chosen; Unit/Deal/Customer/Proyek/Lead dropdowns all lazy-load real records with correct label formats; create-with-unit and create-with-customer succeed with 'Tugas dibuat' toast and the relation is visible in the task list ('To-do · unit', 'To-do · customer'); validation guard blocks submit with toast 'Pilih record terkaitnya dari daftar.'; switching back to 'Tanpa kaitan' clears/disables the record select and submit succeeds without relation; jobdesk SM-10 prefill (title/type/priority + rule note) still works and SM-10 + Lead relation creates 200. Backend pytest suite (8 tests) 100% pass: customer relation persisted, fake customer id -> 404, SM-10 + lead -> 200, all 5 dropdown source endpoints return {data:[...]}. Only gap found: the task DETAIL SHEET does not display the related entity at all (no name, no 'Buka halaman kerja' link) for non-lead relations.

ui_bugs.issue: Related entity is NOT shown in the detail sheet. For a task linked to a unit/customer/deal/project, the 'Aturan jobdesk' card shows no relation row and t.link is null so the [data-testid='task-link-button'] ('Buka halaman kerja') never renders — user cannot see or open the linked record. Only the list row hints the raw type string ('To-do · unit'), never the record name/code.
SheetDescription renders a dangling '- ·' for ad-hoc tasks with no division and no due date (observed literally '- ·' under the title). Should hide empty segments.

action_items: Show the related record in TaskDetailSheet (type label + record name/code) and provide a navigation link for unit/customer/deal/project relations (backend detail response currently returns link=null for these types).
Optional: hide empty division/due segments in the detail-sheet description to avoid the '- ·' artifact.
critical_code_review_comments: CreateTaskDialog: record labels use cfg.toLabel(r) inside SelectContent; if form.rel_type is cleared while options are cached, cfg could be undefined — currently safe because the map source is keyed by rel_type, but consider a null-guard.

CreateTaskDialog lazy loader caches per type for the dialog's lifetime (relRecords never invalidated), so records created elsewhere won't appear until page reload — acceptable, but worth a refresh on dialog open.
Dropdown endpoints are hard-limited (leads 100, units 200, customers 100). With growing data users cannot reach older records; a searchable combobox would scale better.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (core flows); 1 medium gap in detail-sheet relation display

seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted 8 tasks titled TEST_P111* (via API + UI). DB cleaned; no seeded data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login testids: login-email-input / login-password-input / login-submit-button. /tasks table rows use [data-testid='task-row']; the detail sheet opens by clicking the ROW itself — [data-testid='task-open-button'] exists only in TaskCard (kanban/board), NOT in the table view. Radix Select: click trigger, wait 300-500ms, then click [role='option']. Customer labels show name only because seeded customers mostly have email=null (data, not a bug). Related-record dropdown counts observed: leads 97, units 18, deals 4, customers 8, projects 1.
rca_of_the_issue: Detail-sheet gap: TaskDetailSheet.js only references related_entity_* for the lead WA-manual block (line 91) and renders the link button solely when backend supplies t.link; no generic related-entity row exists, so newly supported unit/customer/deal/project relations are invisible after creation.
